title: List what can be sold
prompt: Return the name and price of every product that can be sold: it has more than 0 in stock and it is not discontinued. The starter tests the stock only.
hints: Is there a product with stock that is also discontinued? Look at the starter's result and at schema.sql.
Both tests must be true for a product to be kept.
Add AND discontinued = false to the WHERE clause.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Joins the two tests with OR, so one true test is enough.
Lets through products with exactly 0 in stock.

feedback: Take one row named in the failure and test it by hand against both conditions.
